Errors Found: Hardcoded ElevenLabs secret-like API key in client bundle/localStorage default path; missing-key behavior would silently use embedded key.

Notes: External-services plus browser permissions make this a high-risk integration flow. Fix rollback: revert src/services/ElevenLabs/base.ts only, but do not restore compromised keys; rotate any exposed ElevenLabs key in dashboard.
